1. [Book bus from Toblach to Lago di Braies](https://www.prags.bz/en/offer/detail/shuttle-pragser-wildsee-lake_21)  
   1. Check weather in advance \- if good, we have lunch at Lago di Braise and then hike directly to Rifugio Fodara Vedla. If bad in the afternoon, we fast game hike to Sennes/Fodara Vedla for lunch  
   2. Consider booking 9am one (even though less buffer time, it is generally on-time and even if late, we just book a later bus on the day and have lunch at lago di braies instead)  
   3. Either the 9am or 9.30am bus would mean we reach the trailhead at around 10am or 10.30am. That means we will only reach Rifugio Biella for lunch at 1.30pm to 2pm (if we hike fast). If we are slow, we can expect to reach between 2pm to 3pm+.  
   4. Alternative is to eat lunch at Lago di Braise at 11\~11.30am and then hike for 5hrs+ directly to Rifugio Fodara Vedla. Might be a bit rush though.

# Itinerary

## Part 1 (day hikes)

1. Val Di Funes  
   7 Sep (Mon) \- warm-up hike: [Viewpoint Santa Maddalena](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/italy/south-tyrol/punto-panoramico-santa-maddalena) (1.5 hrs to and fro)  
   8 Sep (Tue) \- [Adolf Munkel Trail](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/italy/south-tyrol/via-delle-odle-zanser-alm-rifugio-delle-odle-malga-dusler) (3.5 hrs loop) / [Tullen summit](https://www.moonhoneytravel.com/tullen-peak-hike-odle-d-eores-dolomites/) (6 hours)  
2. Seceda   
   9 Sep (Wed)  \- [Santa Cristina \- Rifugio Firenze \- Seceda](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/italy/south-tyrol/santa-cristina-rifugio-firenze-seceda) (4 hrs)  
- Check weather [Livecam Seceda](https://www.valgardena.it/en/webcams/seceda-live/) before going  
- [Hotel Kabis to Santa Cristina](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Hotel+Kabis,+Peterweg,+14,+39040+San+Pietro+BZ,+Italy/Parkplatz,+Ruacia+Str.,+39048+S%C3%ABlva,+Autonome+Provinz+Bozen+-+S%C3%BCdtirol,+Italy/@46.6066847,11.5463788,12z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x477811b8554913cf:0x436feaee9d87edae!2m2!1d11.6800749!2d46.6423316!1m5!1m1!1s0x477814994b68e629:0xe45cdce15252f3b1!2m2!1d11.7288925!2d46.556967!3e0?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) (1 hr drive)  
- Descent: [Chairlift Fermeda](https://www.seceda.it/en/summer) followed by [Col Raiser Gondola](https://www.colraiser.it/en/) back to Santa Cristina  
3. 10 Sep (Thurs) [Via ferrata](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/italy/south-tyrol/via-ferrata-brigata-tridentina-al-pisciadu) [Brigata Tridentina](https://inafarawayland.com/via-ferrata-brigata-tridentina/) (Should do this before Sassolungo as this place is closer to Seceda). [AllTrails](https://www.alltrails.com/explore/custom-routes/via-ferrata-brigata-tridentina-37cfaf0) map.  
- [Hotel Garni Morene to Trailhead](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Garni+Morene,+Streda+Puez,+49,+39048+Selva+di+Val+Gardena+BZ,+Italy/Parking+M%C3%ABisules,+Passo+Gardena,+39033+S%C3%ABlva,+Autonome+Provinz+Bozen+-+S%C3%BCdtirol,+Italy/@46.5455194,11.7594592,14z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x477814e5364f049d:0xb57aae3f3457296e!2m2!1d11.7610673!2d46.5587348!1m5!1m1!1s0x47781520be5eabcf:0xa54d0e218aa93ff7!2m2!1d11.8092182!2d46.5499317!3e0?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) (30 mins)  
  1. Famous for its suspension bridge  
  2. Has a Rifugio at the top (for a meal break)  
  3. Summit has nice views too  
4. 11 Sep (Fri) [Sassolungo](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/italy/south-tyrol/giro-del-gruppo-del-sassolungo)

	      \- [Mozart NestHouse to Trailhead](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Mozart+NestHouse,+Via+Roma,+27,+38032+Canazei+TN,+Italy/Parcheggio,+39048+Selva+di+Val+Gardena+BZ,+Italy/@46.4908723,11.7536313,14z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x47786a69bb6f5c5d:0x1c4ff5f5c4c83200!2m2!1d11.7659692!2d46.476781!1m5!1m1!1s0x47786bfc29fd13a7:0xd1dd03c51b3eb4e4!2m2!1d11.7576674!2d46.5093389!3e0?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) (30 mins)

1. An alternative to the Tre Cime Circuit  
   2. Pros: more huts along circuit and less crowds vs Tre Cime Circuit while still having good views  
5. 12 Sep (Sat) [Piz Boe summit](https://inafarawayland.com/piz-boe-summit-hike/),   
   1. [Mozart NestHouse to Passo Pordoi](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Mozart+NestHouse,+Via+Roma,+27,+38032+Canazei+TN,+Italy/Parking+Passo+Pordoi,+38032+Canazei+TN,+Italy/@46.4841513,11.7778886,15z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m14!4m13!1m5!1m1!1s0x47786a69bb6f5c5d:0x1c4ff5f5c4c83200!2m2!1d11.7659692!2d46.476781!1m5!1m1!1s0x477841e45c1e738b:0xeb51b5d8851f7ca7!2m2!1d11.8104543!2d46.488107!3e0?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) (30 mins), take cable car to Rifugio Maria.  
   2. [AllTrails](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/italy/trentino/piz-boe-via-sasso-pordoi) Map from Rifugio Maria  
   3. Has a difficult [via ferrata](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/italy/veneto/ferrata-piazzetta-piz-boe) route  
6. TBC \- Rest day (any day from 9 to 12 sep in case of rain OR exhaustion from hikings .)   
   1. Exploring Dolomites [hidden villages](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/Santa+Cristina+Valgardena,+39047+Autonomous+Province+of+Bolzano+%E2%80%93+South+Tyrol,+Italy/Gardena+Pass,+39033+Corvara,+Autonomous+Province+of+Bolzano+%E2%80%93+South+Tyrol,+Italy/Calfosch,+39033+Autonomous+Province+of+Bolzano+%E2%80%93+South+Tyrol,+Italy/Via+S.+Senese,+39030+San+Genesio+BZ,+Italy/Luch+De+Survisc+Agriturismo,+Cians,+13,+39030+La+Valle+BZ,+Italy/Str.+Picolin,+71,+39030+Marebbe+BZ,+Italy/W%C3%BCrzjoch,+39030+San+Martin+de+Tor,+Autonomous+Province+of+Bolzano+%E2%80%93+South+Tyrol,+Italy/@46.5930636,11.753244,11.67z/data=!3m1!5s0x47783cd723237783:0x150d2a750dcad81b!4m44!4m43!1m5!1m1!1s0x4778136248baa5db:0xd60b93a48456f1d4!2m2!1d11.7222522!2d46.5579405!1m5!1m1!1s0x47781565cba253b9:0xcc38e293b7108587!2m2!1d11.809444!2d46.55!1m5!1m1!1s0x47783fb14fbd4961:0xa070989abe48be0!2m2!1d11.8546144!2d46.5534301!1m5!1m1!1s0x47783cda68b36767:0x3ca391a2abd49fc1!2m2!1d11.9241543!2d46.658242!1m5!1m1!1s0x47783cd7af0db73f:0x2974a5fcc6ac03b5!2m2!1d11.9216843!2d46.6613158!1m5!1m1!1s0x477822981e81afff:0xc3aca0a64577f90e!2m2!1d11.8915197!2d46.6931095!1m5!1m1!1s0x4778177bfcad1ef3:0x4e21093f63ed3cca!2m2!1d11.814167!2d46.675!3e0?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDIxOC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)  
   2. OR Day trip to [Bolzano](https://embracesomeplace.com/bolzano-italy/)   
   3. OR cycling in [Alpe di Siusi](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/italy/south-tyrol/ortisei-alpe-siusi)  
7. 13 Sep (Sun) Marmolada (Queen of Dolomites \- highest peak in Dolomites)

	OR   
	Rest day \- Chill around Cortina d'Ampezzo and prepare for Alta Via 1

## Part 2 (hut-to-hut hike)

\[RandyOrTan\] 5-day Alta Via 1 Itinerary \- [AllTrails](https://www.alltrails.com/explore/custom-routes/copy-5-day-alta-via-1-itinerary-f0e52b8)

1. 14 Sep (Mon)  
   1. Take bus from [Cortina to Lago de braies](https://www.in-moments.com/dolomites/planning-our-10-day-dolomites-trip)  
      1. [Bus 445 from Cortina to Toblach](https://www.suedtirolmobil.info/fileadmin/pdf/2026/445_20260614.pdf)  
      2. [Bus 442 from Toblach to Lago di Braies/Pragser Wildsee](https://www.suedtirolmobil.info/fileadmin/pdf/2026/442_20260614.pdf) ([booking](https://www.prags.bz/en/offer/detail/shuttle-pragser-wildsee-lake_21))  
   2. Use [suedtirolmobil](https://www.suedtirolmobil.info/en/#/) for correct bus info  
   3. Starting [bus stop](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yKDJ9wRL2crzZF5p6) in Cortina  
   4. Free parking near bus stop (The free parking place by in-moments might be closed):  
      1. Can also try asking the hotel if we can park our car with them for the few nights  
      2. [https://maps.app.goo.gl/EUzGsWDF2BGCNo2V9](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EUzGsWDF2BGCNo2V9) (see [this](https://www.serviziampezzo.it/parcheggi/parcheggi-cortina-gratuiti/))  
      3. [https://maps.app.goo.gl/DBkq536kBiuKa1sv8](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DBkq536kBiuKa1sv8)  
      4. [https://maps.app.goo.gl/UELjBdceMLFtJdSF6](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UELjBdceMLFtJdSF6)  
   5. Lago de braies to Rifugio Fodara,   
2. 15 Sep (Tue) \- Rifugio Fodara to Scotoni Hutte  
3. 16 Sep (Wed) \- Scotoni Hutte to Rifugio 5 Torri  
4. 17 Sep (Thu) \- Rifugio 5 Torri to Rifugio Croda da Lago  
5. 18 Sep (Fri) \- Rifugio Croda da Lago \> Cortina \> Bologna  
   1. [Route from Cortina carpark to Bologna airbnb](https://maps.app.goo.gl/px9ywHuK8n5eg1gd9) (4hr drive)  
6. 19 Sep (Sat) \- Bologna to Milan airport  
   1. [Route from airbnb to airport](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UQvo7S6pL2oMcWvJ9) (2hr30mins drive)  
   2. Car to be returned by 1530hr
